title: Sounding Line Direct Candidate Verification
summary: A focused protected-main check binds the exact pull-request base, candidate, and trees; it runs repository safety sentinels and structurally affected proof, widening safely when impact is uncertain. Immutable v1.4 evidence receipts safely preserve or rebind unchanged ordinary obligations while a separate manual mode remains exhaustive for releases and explicit full certification. Selective Product Experience Engineering requires meaningful visible outcomes, responsive real-browser capture, separate criticism, bounded repair and source-bound protected capture/review attestation for affected UI.
subfeatures: Exact base, candidate, and tree identity binding
Conservative widening when impact is unknown
Fail-closed semantic reconciliation of immutable ordinary-evidence receipts
Automatic UI/projection impact and complete cross-project experience selection
Semantic visible-control journeys with keyboard, roles, devices and motion evidence
Authenticated protected-workflow screenshot/recording and independent review binding
Bounded repair and accountable pre-existing experience debt
limitations: Control-plane changes use the explicit owner-authorized manual check rather than ordinary product admission.
Initial representative account contract is executable; affected spatial intent contracts require complete task-specific design and do not claim a completed refit.
AI/browser review does not grant owner product acceptance or physical-device qualification.
Protected experience artifacts expire after 90 days and then require fresh capture/review.
